name: Kutt
description: Short link maker with custom domains, stats and an API

paths.name: Db
paths.description: The SQLite database with your links, stats and users, and this install's JWT secret (.icestore-jwt-secret). Back it up.

paths.name: Custom
paths.description: Your own logo, styles and pages to change how Kutt looks.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Kutt web app, short links and API, published on host as 6859

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: DEFAULT_DOMAIN
variables.description: The address short links start with: replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like 192.168.1.20:6859, or your own domain.

variables.name: SITE_NAME
variables.description: The name shown on the page.
